content: Open every day, 11:00 to 22:00. (每天營業，11:00 至 22:00。)
No. 33, Vinyl Road, Gushan District, Kaohsiung (高雄市鼓山區黑膠路33號).
We accept cash and LINE Pay. (我們接受現金與 LINE Pay。)
Yes, you can buy records here. A staff member will help you with this. (可以在店內購買黑膠唱片，由店員為您服務。)
Sorry, we do not offer delivery. (很抱歉，我們不提供外送服務。)
Parking is in front of the shop, but there are only 10 parking spots. (店門前有停車位，但只有 10 個車位。)

You request a song and it is put in the queue. When all earlier songs have finished playing, your song comes next. You can also stop your own song. Our staff can also change the queue themselves. (您點一首歌後，歌曲會加入播放佇列；前面的歌曲都播完後，就會輪到您的歌。您也可以自己停止自己點的歌。店員也可以自行調整播放佇列。)
We offer free Wi-Fi. Please ask our staff for the password. (我們提供免費 Wi-Fi，請向店員詢問密碼。)
No reservation is needed. Walk-in guests are welcome. (不需要訂位，歡迎直接入座。)
